record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Sheminith<WH08067>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Help<WH03467><WTH8685>, LORD<WH03068>; for the godly man<WH02623> ceaseth<WH01584><WTH8804>; for the faithful<WH0539><WTH8803> fail<WH06461><WTH8804> from among the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>. <RF>upon...: or, upon the eighth<Rf> <RF>Help: or, Save<Rf>

They speak<WH01696><WTH8762> vanity<WH07723> every one<WH0376> with his neighbour<WH07453>: <FI>with<Fi> flattering<WH02513> lips<WH08193> <FI>and<Fi> with a double<WH03820> heart<WH03820> do they speak<WH01696><WTH8762>. <RF>a double...: Heb. an heart and an heart<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> shall cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> all flattering<WH02513> lips<WH08193>, <FI>and<Fi> the tongue<WH03956> that speaketh<WH01696><WTH8764> proud<WH01419> things: <RF>proud: Heb. great<Rf>

Who have said<WH0559><WTH8804>, With our tongue<WH03956> will we prevail<WH01396><WTH8686>; our lips<WH08193> <FI>are<Fi> our own: who <FI>is<Fi> lord<WH0113> over us? <RF>are...: Heb. are with us<Rf>

For the oppression<WH07701> of the poor<WH06041>, for the sighing<WH0603> of the needy<WH034>, now will I arise<WH06965><WTH8799>, saith<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>; I will set<WH07896><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> in safety<WH03468> <FI>from him that<Fi>  puffeth<WH06315><WTH8686> at him. <RF>puffeth...: or, would ensnare him<Rf>

The words<WH0565> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>are<Fi> pure<WH02889> words<WH0565>: <FI>as<Fi> silver<WH03701> tried<WH06884><WTH8803> in a furnace<WH05948> of earth<WH0776>, purified<WH02212><WTH8794> seven times<WH07659>.

Thou shalt keep<WH08104><WTH8799> them, O LORD<WH03068>, thou shalt preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> them from this<WH02098> generation<WH01755> for ever<WH05769>. <RF>them from: Heb. him, etc: that is, every one of them, etc<Rf>
The wicked<WH07563> walk<WH01980><WTH8691> on every side<WH05439>, when the vilest<WH02149> men<WH01121><WH0120> are exalted<WH07311><WTH8800>. <RF>men: Heb. of the sons of the men<Rf><CM>
